attributes.residual: STALE-LABEL CORRECTION, the main finding. The v1 cap recorded the residual as 'target literal lis/addi has no relocation while current extern gPadManager emits HA/LO' PLUS the zero-copy rotation, and classified it STRUCTURAL. Re-derived from the aligned fnasm --diff view 2026-08-31: the relocation half is GONE from the measured diff entirely (config/GUNE5D/config.yml block_relocations at 0x800CB514/0x800CB528 cover it; the HA/LO row now reads as an ordinary opcode-only match). What remains is EXACTLY 3 sites of the live-zero family and nothing else: fndiff --ops gives target-only '+2 addi +1 mr' against ours-only '-3 li'. Target emits li r29,0 then mr r30,r29 (maskB=maskA), addi r7,r29,0 (i) and addi r3,r29,0 (byte-offset IV); ours emits four independent li. The one remaining schedule row (target puts addi r31,r3,25692 at 0x18 between li r29,0 and mr r30,r29, ours puts addi r31 at 0x14 ahead of both) is a KNOCK-ON, not an independent lever: target's mr r30,r29 is data-dependent on r29 so the scheduler has a slot to fill after li r29,0, while ours' two independent li leave no gap. One root cause, correctly classified REGISTER_ONLY rather than the v1 record's STRUCTURAL.
